answer: Since the throttle counters live in the oasis ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 20 keys thus pays for 20 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the basalt quota and the terrace admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
